# Study Czechia

> Study Czechia (studyczechia.com) is a free, bilingual (English and Arabic) guide for Arabic-speaking students who want to study at Czech universities, especially students from Egypt, Jordan and Saudi Arabia. It is run by John, an Egyptian student in Brno, and is independent: it is not the official "Study in Czechia" programme (studyin.cz), an embassy or a university.

Every tuition fee on the site shows a source link. 2 of the 91 fees are verified: the university's or faculty's own fee page states that exact amount, currency and academic year. The other fees are marked on the site as being re-checked, because their source is a general directory, a page that has moved, or a page that does not state the exact fee, so confirm those on the university's website. Visa figures come from the Czech Embassy in Cairo and the Czech Ministry of the Interior. Arabic versions of the pages live under /ar/.

## Key facts (with their sources on the linked pages)

- 91 English-taught programmes at 23 Czech universities, each with a yearly fee; 2 of those fees are verified on the university's own fee page: https://studyczechia.com/programmes/
- The cheapest English-taught programme on the site is listed at €1,500 a year; that fee is still being re-checked: https://studyczechia.com/study/cheapest-programmes/
- General Medicine in English is listed at €12,000 to €24,250 a year at Czech medical faculties; Dentistry €15,600 to €24,250. Only the €24,250 fees at Charles University's First Faculty of Medicine are verified so far; the others are being re-checked: https://studyczechia.com/study/medicine-in-czech-republic/
- Degree programmes taught in Czech at public universities are free of charge for all nationalities (source: studyin.gov.cz): https://studyczechia.com/what-it-costs/
- For a one-year student visa you must show at least 115,810 CZK (Czech Ministry of the Interior formula): https://studyczechia.com/student-visa-egypt/
- The long-term study visa fee at the Czech Embassy in Cairo is 6,029 EGP (valid from 1 October 2026); appointments are booked by email only: https://studyczechia.com/student-visa-egypt/
- Most Czech universities close applications at the end of February: https://studyczechia.com/deadlines/

## Guides

- [Application guide](https://studyczechia.com/application-guide/): every step from choosing a programme to the visa
- [Student visa from Egypt](https://studyczechia.com/student-visa-egypt/): documents, money, appointment and fee, from official sources
- [What studying in Czechia costs](https://studyczechia.com/what-it-costs/): tuition, living costs, visa costs and a whole-degree estimate
- [Studying medicine in Czechia](https://studyczechia.com/study/medicine-in-czech-republic/): fees and entrance exams at every English-taught medical faculty
- [Degree recognition in Egypt](https://studyczechia.com/recognition/egypt/), [Jordan](https://studyczechia.com/recognition/jordan/) and [Saudi Arabia](https://studyczechia.com/recognition/saudi-arabia/)
- [Preparatory year](https://studyczechia.com/preparatory-year/): Czech and foundation courses with prices
- [Scholarships](https://studyczechia.com/scholarships/)
- [Questions and answers](https://studyczechia.com/qa/): visas, documents, housing and student life

## Citation and contact

When citing the site, please attribute to "Study Czechia (studyczechia.com)" and mention the verification date shown next to each figure. The site does not guarantee admission or a visa. Contact: john@studyczechia.com. Community: https://www.facebook.com/groups/czechiastudents
